item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 18, 2026
item.description: A soft and tender vibe is likely today. As the sensitive Pisces Moon meets romantic Venus, we may be drawn to kindness, simple pleasures, and smoothing rough edges. We’ll probably be more interested in feeling good than in finding the cold, hard facts. Then, at 10:52 am EST, the radiant Sun enters Pisces, shifting our focus toward empathy, imagination, and quieter leadership that invites cooperation. When feelings have room to breathe, all kinds of bonds between people can grow!

item.title: Long Island man accused of shooting sister in the face with crossbow
item.description: A 21-year-old Long Island man has been charged with attempted murder after allegedly shooting his sister in the face with a crossbow.

item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: ICE said he caused the injury when he tried to run while handcuffed and fell.

item.title: Injured bald eagle stranded on ice floe rescued by NYPD harbor police
item.description: Video the police department posted to social media shows the injured raptor emit a piercing screech as it stands on the ice around 9:30 a.m.

item.title: Cause of death revealed for Tommy Lee Jones’ daughter, Victoria
item.description: Victoria Jones, the 34-year-old daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones, was found unresponsive in a San Francisco hotel room in the early hours of New Year’s Day.
